title: AI Art Nouveau Generator
summary: Make art nouveau style images and video with AI: flowing hair, whiplash curves, flowers and ornamental frames. Describe it, pick a style, and generate.
body_markdown:
### What is the art nouveau style?


Art nouveau is a decorative art style of about 1890 to 1910, known for long flowing lines inspired by plants, flowers and hair, flat muted colour, ornamental borders and stylised women, used in posters, stained glass, jewellery, furniture and architecture.


### What are the main features of art nouveau?


Whiplash curves and flowing organic lines, motifs from nature such as lilies, irises, dragonflies and peacocks, decorative frames and halos, flat soft colour with gold accents, and the same line carried through every part of a design.


### How do I make art nouveau art with AI?


Describe the figure with its flowing hair or stems, a halo or ornamental frame and a muted palette, such as a woman in profile framed by lilies in sage, ochre and rose, then pick an art nouveau style and generate. In Flick you can then animate the still into a clip.


### Can I make an art nouveau poster with AI?


Yes. Describe one central figure, a circular halo or arched frame, flowing curves and flat colour with a lithograph texture; generate it without text, then add your own lettering in a design tool, since generated letters often come out wrong.


### Can I make an art nouveau video?


Yes. Generate the still first, then use it as the start frame of an image to video model in Flick and describe gentle motion, such as hair lifting in a breeze or leaves drifting down, while asking to keep the flat outlines and colours.


### Is the art nouveau generator free?


Yes, it is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every day with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6 runs on it. Video models such as Seedance 2.5 need the Standard plan ($20 a month).
